request: Analyze GSE229755 for the paper (Multi-omics analysis explores the effect of chronic exercise on liver metabolic reprogramming in mice; PMID 37408533): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq of liver, DNBseq PE150, HISAT2 to GRCm39
final.sample_inclusion: 12 mice for transcriptomics, n = 6 per group (S2.3.p1); PCA was used to exclude outliers but none are reported excluded from the n = 6 + 6
final.primary_estimand: Effect of 6 weeks of chronic moderate-intensity treadmill exercise on the mouse liver transcriptome (Exe vs Con, independent animals)
planned_contrasts: Exe vs Con (S3.1.p1; paper: 88 DEGs, 28 up / 60 down)
final.paper_results: 88 DEGs (28 up, 60 down); Cyp4a10, Cyp4a14 up at mRNA and protein; Cyp1a1 in retinol metabolism (S3.1.p1, S3.3.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.1.p1: two randomized groups Exe and Con; S2.3.p1: n = 6 per group for transcriptomics; S2.4.p1: DESeq, |log2FC| > 1 and Q-value <= 0.05; S3.1.p1: 88 DEGs (28 up, 60 down); S3.3.p1 and S4.p2: Cyp4a10 and Cyp4a14 upregulated.

checks: S6.p1 names GSE229755 as the transcriptomics deposit
GEO: liver, Mus musculus, 12 samples Con_L1-6 and Exe_L1-6, treatment sedentary vs chronic exercise running 6 weeks
extract_protocol and data_processing match S2.4.p1 (TRIzol, DNBseq PE150, HISAT to GCF_000001635.27_GRCm39)

ownership.reasoning: Data availability statement S6.p1 names GSE229755; the 12 GEO samples and processing text match the paper's transcriptomics methods.

alignment.reasoning: The merged matrix columns are GSM ids taken from the _RAW.tar member names (GSM7177389_Con_L1.txt.gz ...), which equal the metadata index. Group derived from title (Con_L# / Exe_L#), consistent with characteristics treatment (sedentary / chronic exercise).

matrix.reasoning: The only deposited expression data are per-sample files with a single value column named fpkm_<title> holding non-integer values (median 2.3, max 3.8e4) indexed by Entrez gene_id and gene_symbol; no read-count file exists in GEO. The paper's DESeq input (raw counts) was not deposited. Merged by prep_merge_fpkm.py (16,821 genes, duplicated symbols resolved by highest mean).

candidates.reason_rejected: identical split to title/treatment; title gives short formula-safe levels

design.reasoning: S2.1.p1 randomizes mice to Exe and Con; S3.1.p1 compares Exe with Con. One two-level factor, independent animals, all male.

covariance.reasoning: Independent animals, one sample each; no batch, sex (all male, S2.1.p1) or lane covariate recorded in GEO; the paper models group only.

paper_route.reason: GEO GSE229755 deposits only per-sample FPKM; no raw counts are available, and FPKM must not be rounded into counts

deviations: limma on log2(FPKM+1) instead of DESeq on counts
genes with FPKM < 1 in more than 9 of 12 samples removed (FPKM >= 1 in at least 3 samples) before limma, replacing DESeq's independent filtering; unfiltered run kept as sensitivity

method.reasoning: Matrix policy: FPKM -> log2(x+1) -> limma. DESeq is blocked because counts are not deposited; run limma as a declared deviation with the paper's threshold.

final.deviation_note: Paper's Q-value <= 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1 applied to limma BH-adjusted p and log2FC of log2(FPKM+1) instead of DESeq on counts.

threshold.reasoning: S2.4.p1 and S3.1.p1: |log2FC| > 1 and Q-value <= 0.05 (Q-value read as BH-adjusted p). Audit rule: BH < 0.05 with no fold-change cutoff.

caveats: Counts not deposited: limma-trend on log2(FPKM+1) replaces DESeq on counts, so DEG numbers are not directly comparable
Fold changes on log2(FPKM+1) are shrunk toward zero for low-expressed genes compared with DESeq count fold changes

study.reasoning: Paper reports 88 DEGs (28 up, 60 down) and names Cyp4a10/Cyp4a14 (up) and Cyp1a1 among retinol metabolism DEGs.

discrepancies.data: GEO data_processing also says 'Assembly: mm10' and mentions Bowtie2 to reference gene sequences

executions.name: grp_Exe_vs_Con
executions.reasoning: Paper's Exe vs Con contrast on the deviation route (limma on log2(FPKM+1)); unexpressed genes removed (FPKM >= 1 in at least 3 of 12 samples, the smallest group size being 6).

executions.name: grp_Exe_vs_Con_unfiltered
executions.reasoning: Same contrast without the expression filter, to show the filter's effect on counts.

enrichment.reasoning: Paper reports GO/KEGG enrichment of the DEGs (S2.4.p1, S3.1.p1).
